    @pytest.mark.priority(4)
    def test_hover_dialog_info_icons_and_validate_definitions(self):
        """Hover each info icon in dialog headers, validate tooltip definition matches HoverJson."""
        # self.body_composition.open_body_composition_dialog()
        # BasePage.wait_for_visible(self, "//div[text()='Last month']")
        # self.page.locator("//div[text()='Last month']").click()
        # BasePage.wait_for_visible(self, "//div[text()='All']")
        # self.page.locator("//div[text()='All']").click()
        ths = self.body_composition.page.locator(BodyCompositionPage.DIALOG_TABLE_HEADERS)
        info_icons = self.body_composition.page.locator(BodyCompositionPage.DIALOG_TABLE_INFO_ICONS)
        header_count = ths.count()
        assert header_count > 0, "No headers found in the Body Composition dialog table"
    
        icon_index = 0
        for i in range(header_count):
            th = ths.nth(i)
            has_icon = th.locator(".fa-circle-info").count() > 0
            if not has_icon:
                continue
    
            icon = info_icons.nth(icon_index)
            icon.scroll_into_view_if_needed()
            icon.hover()
            self.body_composition.page.wait_for_timeout(800)
    
            tooltip = self.body_composition.page.locator(BodyCompositionPage.DIALOG_TOOLTIP)
            assert tooltip.is_visible(), f"Tooltip not visible for icon at index {icon_index}"
